rag-architecture.author: Microsoft
rag-architecture.title: RAG has an indexing path and a request path
rag-architecture.alt: A retrieval-augmented generation architecture separates the ingestion and indexing pipeline from the online retrieval and answer flow.
rag-architecture.description: Source preparation builds the searchable representation. A request retrieves evidence and assembles model context. Investigate those paths separately when answers are stale, unsupported or incomplete.

sales-star.author: Microsoft
sales-star.title: A sales star with five dimensions
sales-star.alt: Sales facts at the centre relate to Date, Customer, Salesperson, Product and Sales Region dimensions.
sales-star.description: Trace each dimension key into the central Sales fact. A dimension can describe many facts while each fact keeps its declared grain.

kubernetes-components.author: The Kubernetes Authors
kubernetes-components.title: Control plane and worker-node components
kubernetes-components.alt: Kubernetes control-plane components coordinate worker nodes that run kubelet, networking components and Pods.
kubernetes-components.description: The scheduler chooses placement for an unscheduled Pod. Controllers reconcile workload state, and kubelet manages the assigned Pod on its node. Machine capacity remains a separate concern.

parquet-layout.author: Apache Software Foundation
parquet-layout.title: Inside a Parquet file
parquet-layout.alt: A Parquet file contains row groups, column chunks and pages, followed by file metadata that points to stored chunks.
parquet-layout.description: File size, row-group size and page size describe different units. Metadata lets a reader locate selected columns and eligible row groups without decoding every stored value.

scd-type-1.author: Microsoft
scd-type-1.title: Type 1: overwrite the changed value
scd-type-1.alt: A salesperson dimension shows a phone number before and after an overwrite, with the same row identity.
scd-type-1.description: The replacement phone number occupies the existing dimension row. Queries using that row see the corrected value for earlier facts as well.

kappa.author: Microsoft
kappa.title: Kappa architecture: a stream-processing path
kappa.alt: A unified event log feeds a speed layer and a long-term store; archived events can be recomputed into the real-time view.
kappa.description: One processing model serves the event stream. Rebuilding a view still requires retained input, compatible state and enough capacity to replay while live traffic continues.

product-snowflake.author: Microsoft
product-snowflake.title: A normalized product hierarchy
product-snowflake.alt: The Product dimension relates to Subcategory, which relates to Category, extending one branch of a sales star.
product-snowflake.description: The category is stored at the end of a dimension hierarchy. Reconstructing a product classification requires following the joins through Subcategory.

multivalued-dimension.author: Microsoft
multivalued-dimension.title: A bridge makes a many-to-many relationship explicit
multivalued-dimension.alt: Customer and Account are connected through a Customer Account bridge; Transaction facts reference Account.
multivalued-dimension.description: A customer can have several accounts and an account can have several customers. The bridge records membership. Allocating a transaction to owners additionally needs an explicit weighting policy.

iceberg-metadata.author: Apache Software Foundation
iceberg-metadata.title: Iceberg snapshots point to manifests and data files
iceberg-metadata.alt: A catalog points to table metadata; snapshots reference manifest lists, manifests and data files.
iceberg-metadata.description: The metadata chain selects the files belonging to a snapshot. Retaining metadata cannot recover a data file already removed by cleanup. This figure illustrates Iceberg; Delta uses a different log structure.

conformed-dimensions.author: Microsoft
conformed-dimensions.title: Two fact tables sharing conformed dimensions
conformed-dimensions.alt: Sales and Inventory facts share Date and Product dimensions, while retaining their own measures and other dimensions.
conformed-dimensions.description: Sales and Inventory reuse Date and Product definitions. Aggregate each process to the comparison grain before combining measures across the two fact tables.

scd-type-2.author: Microsoft
scd-type-2.title: Type 2: preserve versions as separate rows
scd-type-2.alt: A salesperson dimension adds a new version with a different surrogate key and tracks start date, end date and current status.
scd-type-2.description: A new salesperson version gets its own surrogate key. The article below uses half-open validity intervals; translate the source figure's date conventions before copying its values into a timestamp join.

lambda.author: Microsoft
lambda.title: Lambda architecture: batch and speed paths
lambda.alt: An input stream feeds a batch layer and a speed layer; serving combines batch views and real-time views.
lambda.description: The two paths cover history and recent events. Define their coverage cutoff and reconciliation rule so serving neither double counts events nor leaves a gap.

query-stages.author: Google
query-stages.title: A distributed BigQuery execution plan
query-stages.alt: A BigQuery execution-details view shows per-stage wait, read, compute and write timings with records read and written.
query-stages.description: Inspect wait, read, compute and write time alongside records read and written for each stage. The screenshot illustrates the evidence available; timings belong to that example job.

partition-cluster.author: Google
partition-cluster.title: Partition elimination followed by block pruning
partition-cluster.alt: Unorganized data is compared with partitioned data and with clustered blocks inside partitions.
partition-cluster.description: A partition predicate narrows the partitions considered. Filters on clustering columns can then prune blocks inside them. The example is BigQuery storage; other engines expose different physical units.

shared-agent-context.title: Shared-context multi-agent system
shared-agent-context.author: LangGraph persistence
shared-agent-context.alt: A supervisor coordinates research, analysis and report agents above durable checkpoints, structured task state, evidence artifacts and scoped memory; storage and tools remain external.
shared-agent-context.description: The supervisor owns task transitions. Agents exchange authorized artifact references and state versions. Storage retains evidence and checkpoints; tool services enforce permissions when operations execute.

warehouse-methods.title: Two places to integrate shared business meaning
warehouse-methods.author: Kimball Group
warehouse-methods.alt: Kimball integrates facts through conformed dimensions, while an Inmon-style design integrates normalized enterprise entities before publishing consumer marts.
warehouse-methods.description: Compare where a shared customer definition is established. Both approaches need coordinated keys and history; the sequencing and integration representation differ.

data-vault-schema.title: Data Vault: identity, relationships and history
data-vault-schema.author: Data Vault Alliance
data-vault-schema.alt: Customer and Order hubs connect through a Customer Order link. Each hub has a satellite with descriptive versions, load time and record source.
data-vault-schema.description: Business keys identify entities, links retain associations and satellites preserve descriptive versions. The simplified satellite key assumes one descriptive record per parent and load timestamp.

medallion-models.title: Medallion: data models and quality responsibilities
medallion-models.author: Databricks data warehousing architecture
medallion-models.alt: Retained bronze input feeds validated silver entities, then gold consumer models. Invalid silver inputs enter a quarantine and repair path.
medallion-models.description: Bronze retains replayable input. Silver establishes typed entities and history. Gold publishes consumer definitions. These are logical responsibilities; the number of physical stages depends on the workload.

delta-platform.title: A lake platform with explicit publication and serving
delta-platform.author: Delta Lake concurrency control
delta-platform.alt: Raw source capture enters a Delta table containing Parquet files and a transaction log, governed by a catalog and access policies, with validated compute and lakehouse or warehouse consumers.
delta-platform.description: A committed transaction-log version determines the table snapshot a reader sees. Catalog and access services surround that table. A separate warehouse copy is justified by serving requirements and needs a correction and freshness policy.
